title: Consolidated Console Topography: Compact Rail + Route Map for Workspace Context
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Replace the current multi-pane navigation with a single, compact primary rail plus an explicit route-map flyout that surfaces workspace context and active routes (dashboards, rollouts, costs) without increasing cognitive load. Scope: IA mappings, high-fidelity prototypes for desktop and tablet, accessibility pass (keyboard + screen reader), migration guidance for existing workspaces, and telemetry hooks for A/B testing. We aim to reduce time-to-target for common tasks (open route, switch workspace, inspect route-level metrics) and offer a stable baseline for Dedicated/Private console variants.
acceptance_criteria: New compact rail implemented in prototype with 6 top-level entry points: Overview, Models, Serving, Dashboards, Rollouts, Billing
Route-map flyout shows current workspace, recent routes, and an inline switch control; switching workspace preserved via optimistic UI and confirmed by telemetry
Accessibility: keyboard-only navigation through rail and flyout; screen reader announcements for workspace changes
Design tokens and spacing align with existing console theme; component variants documented in Figma
Performance: rail and flyout open/close transitions under 150ms in prototype on modern browsers
Telemetry events defined for: rail-click, flyout-open, workspace-switch, route-navigate, route-pin; events instrumented in ENG-2044
comments: 2025-02-11 | Aisha Patel: Initial kickoff — sketched three approaches: stacked rail (current), compact rail (this ticket), and persistent top tab. We converged on compact rail + route-map after PM and Eng agreed on space budget. Links to sketches in attachments.

2025-02-18 | Marco Nguyen: Mid-fidelity prototype ready. Focused on minimizing lateral navigation distance and ensuring the active route is always visible. Uploaded Figma file; requested IA review from PM and Eng.
2025-02-20 | Laila Gomez (PM): Suggest adding a lightweight breadcrumbs line inside the route-map flyout for multi-level rollouts. Need to show rollout status badges. Adding as AC item.

2025-02-24 | Ravi Shah (Engineer): ENG-2044 will provide the telemetry events. One constraint: the private console has deeper latency on flyout renders; recommend client-side caching and skeleton state. Flagging possible implementation dependency.

2025-02-27 | Marco Nguyen: Usability test plan created — 8 participants (internal). Testing tasks: switch workspace, open runbook for rollout, find cost-per-route. Early results: average time-to-switch reduced by 32% vs baseline.

2025-03-02 | Design Review (cross-functional): Feedback: reduce icon density, increase hit target to 44px, clarify workspace avatar affordance. Agree to two variants in prototype: 'compact' and 'spacious' for A/B.

2025-03-03 | Aisha Patel: Updated prototype with accessible focus ring, added aria-live regions for workspace changes, documented keyboard interaction (Ctrl+K opens route search, Shift+Alt+W opens workspace switch capsule).

2025-03-04 | Marco Nguyen: Preparing a PR with component stories and visual tests: design tokens mapped, motion specs added. Requested Eng review on performance and fallback for small screens (collapsing to bottom nav).
decision_log: 2025-02-12: Chose compact rail over top tabs due to vertical space efficiency and alignment with console's current left-anchored mental model.
2025-02-19: Route-map flyout will be transient (not persisted) and should include an inline workspace switch control to avoid context hopping.
2025-02-24: Rollout badges will be shown in the route-map but omitted from collapsed rail to preserve clarity; full details live in the dashboard panel.
2025-03-02: Two A/B variants for density selected to validate icon-only vs icon+label preference across power users and newcomers.
ux_notes: Preserve vertical rhythm: rail items 44px touch target with 12px icon padding
Favor progressive disclosure: show counts and badges only in expanded flyout
Workspace switch should be optimistic: update UI immediately, reconcile with server result; show inline toast on failure
Add telemetry for long-tail flows (user opens >5 different routes in 1 session) to assess migration pain
Document migration steps for customers with many pinned routes — include a bulk-transfer tool in PM-789
